remarks: INCREDIBLE LOCATION AND UTILITIES INCLUDED IN COMMON CHARGES!!! This beautifully maintained end unit is located on the desired first floor. Pristine hardwood floors and custom crown molding throughout! Large living room/dining area combination, eat-in kitchen with gas stove have oversized windows which allow plenty of sunlight! Primary bedroom can easily fit a king-size bed and has tons of closet space. Guest bedroom has ample closet space and plenty of sunlight as well. One full bath with shower/tub and vanity. Brand-new blinds throughout and entire unit just painted in a neutral color! There is an option to install a ventless washer/dryer in the unit's hallway closet or use the convenient washer/dryer located just steps from kitchen door. Heat, hot water, ground maintenance, snow removal and taxes are all included in the monthly Common Charges. One assigned parking spot comes with the unit. Visitor parking included. Minutes to Shops, Restaurants, Park, Beach and easy access to I-95. 45 Mins from New York City! Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
